public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Eon Systems is an AI & Software company at an undisclosed stage with founder Michael Andregg. The valuation exercise draws on a sector comp universe of 9 total peers: 1 public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and 8 private companies including Figure AI, Scale AI, Reflection AI, and Applied Intuition.

Peer-median triangulation is not applicable here. The AI & Software sector contains 12 same-sector comparables, but filtering by stage alignment, adjacency, or valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any narrow cohort. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the wide dispersion in business models, revenue profiles, and capital intensity across the AI & Software landscape. The single public comparable (Palantir) operates at a scale substantially different from most emerging frontier-tech entrants, limiting its direct utility without stage and size adjustments.

The analysis cannot produce a triangulated valuation range without additional data on Eon Systems' revenue, growth rate, funding stage, or comparable transaction multiples within the peer set. A defensible valuation would require either: (i) expansion of the comp set to achieve minimum n≥3 within a narrow filter, or (ii) quantitative disclosure of Eon Systems' financial metrics to enable revenue-multiple, DCF, or venture-return-based approaches. The key uncertainty remains stage-specific positioning relative to the identified peer universe.
